title: DECISION: UTF-8 char boundary awareness in cursor movement
description:
What: Left/Right/Backspace cursor movement explicitly walks bytes backward/forward until hitting a valid char boundary using is_char_boundary().

Why it's good: Prevents cursor from landing in the middle of multi-byte characters (€, 日, etc.). On Backspace, the loop retreats until finding a boundary, then removes the full character. This is the correct approach; ignoring char boundaries would corrupt UTF-8. Tested with hardcoded '€' (3 bytes) to verify cursor moves by full char width.
